name: ModelDocumentMutation
documentation:
Optional current-source or independent public-projection consequence of one Model target transition.

A {@code null} document represents deletion from {@link #collection}. The runtime attaches the target transition's assigned {@code stateIndex} and applies the mutation through a monotone write fence.

fields.name: MIGRATION_COLLECTION
fields.documentation:
Internal collection containing crash-safe direct-document state while published legacy
 events are being rebuilt. Ordinary Model loads and searches never use this collection.

fields.name: PRIVATE_MODEL_DOCUMENT_COLLECTION_PREFIX
fields.documentation: Prefix for type-isolated internal Model sources, including Graph components.

fields.name: collection
fields.documentation:
Current-document collection. Internal sources use type-isolated storage; public DOCUMENT projections use
 their independently configured collection. The owning target field identifies the role.

fields.name: document
fields.documentation: Complete serialized current document, or {@code null} to delete it.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.documentation: Returns the serialized document payload size without counting protocol framing.

methods.name: privateModelDocumentCollection
methods.documentation:
Returns the private search collection for current documents of one Model type.

Type isolation lets direct lookup, relationship search and Graph composition use ordinary document indexes without scanning or mixing unrelated Model types. The logical Model name is already part of the persisted contract and keeps the collection deterministic across SDK instances and Java class/package renames.
